response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT brokrepstat, AVG(modelconf) AS avg_conf FROM compliancecase GROUP BY brokrepstat), b AS (SELECT AVG(modelconf) AS base FROM compliancecase), q AS (SELECT g.brokrepstat, g.avg_conf FROM g, b WHERE g.avg_conf > b.base), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_conf) AS mean_q FROM q) SELECT q.brokrepstat AS brokrepstat, q.avg_conf AS avg_modelconf, q.avg_conf - b.base AS diff_from_baseline, q.avg_conf / m.mean_q AS ratio_to_qualifying_mean FROM q, b, m WHERE b.base IS NOT NULL AND m.mean_q IS NOT NULL

assumptions.assumption: Cases with NULL brokrepstat form their own group (GROUP BY keeps NULL as a group); the status is shown as NULL.
The baseline is the plain AVG(modelconf) over all cases (non-null modelconf only), not an average of the group averages.
The 'mean of the qualifying statuses' averages' is the unweighted mean of the group averages for statuses whose average is strictly above the baseline.
